about: Unit tests of the old word-list path (detector, answer bank, question scope, legacy moments). They were tuned on the sentences they score, so they are in-sample smoke tests, not evidence of quality. Proposed lane: `pnpm test:legacy`, run on its own, not part of the headline check. Measured run time on a loaded machine, ms.

lane.why: hard-coded question and 'about you' word lists
detector plus bank on tuned question sentences
bank trigger words and paraphrases tuned on the same cases
bank rules text and trigger lists
classic question scope over a word-list gate
legacy gate versus v2 on the old labelled lines

staysInMain.why: safety: price, date and promise guards must hold
stops new word lists from entering the core path
language detection by script, no word list

alsoLegacy: pnpm eval 'LEGACY SMOKE, in-sample' block (detector, bank, guards on their own sentences)
